sections.text: مقدمة

This 
document out lines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on an 
annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block

A pump works when the unit has a starting signal but the sequence of starting 
the unit will not take place unless the high pressure pump works and the 
pressure of oil reaches 75 kg/cm2 and the sequence of stopping as well.

The main 
function of this pump is to make a film of oil at thrust bearing between the 
mirror and the bads to to preveist the tilne bads from mechanical friction 
at starting and stopping the unit (for unit no10)

The 
first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Shaban Ibrahem ElBehairy, tested by eng. Hassaan Ahmed
